title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with the City of Boston, Boston Public Schools.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (04-GC-16)
